payload.request: Implement and independently validate the shared-process functional-test migration specified by the source plan.
acceptance: Three consecutive uncached reference-CI make test-functional runs pass in less than three minutes.
Eligible scenarios share package-scoped processes while retaining explicit isolated Factory Sessions and unique durable state.
Tests proving startup, shutdown, malformed configuration, port binding, executable selection, crashes, or process-level environment behavior remain process-isolated and inventoried.
Public Work, Factory Event, dispatch, replay, ACP/AGY, and packaged-factory behavior remains unchanged except for explicitly authorized fixture-only changes.
Cleanup is deterministic and leaks no processes, ports, worktrees, sessions, or runtime state.
Focused race and fixture checks, make test-lane-audit, make test-functional, make verify-fast, and source-plan documentation checks pass.
Two blind clean-room probes independently report PASS for behavior/regression fidelity and reproducible latency/isolation evidence.

recovery.lastKnownStatus: Stories 001-003 completed in the recovered umbrella worktree: inventory spine plus application and process/protocol classification. Timing, lane audit, clean-room validation, package migrations, review, and delivery remain.
recovery.requiredAction: Preserve the recovered umbrella branch as evidence and integration history. Reuse it only for indivisible inventory completion; emit every well-scoped remaining package- or ownership-scoped idea, encode real prerequisites as relations, and let Factory resources control active concurrency.
recovery.partitionDirective: Maximize concurrent package-family lanes. A single child idea requires a concrete serialization reason recorded in Project state.

payload.request: Baseline, optimize, and independently validate the uncached Go unit-test lane.
acceptance: A clean baseline records three uncached make test-unit-fresh runs with wall time, package timing, inventory, jobs, and machine identity.
Three consecutive uncached reference-CI final runs improve median wall time by at least 25 percent versus the accepted baseline, and no final run exceeds the final median by more than 10 percent.
Every canonical unit-lane package and test still executes and passes; all inventory drift is explained and reviewed.
Behavior, race safety, isolation, diagnostics, and package ownership remain intact, with explicit evidence for new parallelism.
make test-unit-fresh, make test, make test-lane-audit, and make verify-fast pass.
CI owns a documented, machine-readable, non-flaky unit-lane latency budget or regression check.
Two blind clean-room probes independently report PASS for correctness/inventory fidelity and reproducible performance/isolation evidence.

recovery.lastKnownStatus: Recovered baseline/witness work and the deterministic latency evidence budget commit are present. Accepted reference baseline/final runs, additional evidence-backed package optimizations, clean-room validation, review, and delivery remain.
recovery.requiredAction: Preserve the recovered umbrella branch and artifacts. Emit the complete known task graph for package hotspots, checker/CI ownership, and other package- or ownership-scoped work; encode real prerequisites as relations and let Factory resources control active concurrency.
recovery.partitionDirective: Maximize concurrent lanes between serialized measurement gates. A single child idea requires a concrete serialization reason recorded in Project state.
